threads.title: Make the islet landing choices readable

events.author: ai
events.body: Observation: the Merlion islet has three swim exits and two shore jetties in src/game/marina-water.ts. Design reading: separate approaches can give players a choice between a direct crossing and a safer landing. Tradeoff: water exposure can make the island feel like a trap if exits are hard to spot. Proposal: review sightlines from both jetties before adding more cover. Verify: approach each ladder from water and each jetty by boat; check that exits are visible and usable. This is a review hypothesis, not a measured balance result.

threads.title: Protect the arrival, preserve rooftop choices

events.author: ai
events.body: Observation: two express lifts arrive on the SkyPark, with rooftop planters and benches defined in src/game/marina-landmarks.ts. Design reading: two arrivals can keep a single defender from controlling every approach. Tradeoff: protection at a lift can become strong camping cover facing the other lift. Proposal: inspect arrival-to-cover and cross-deck sightlines before moving furniture. Verify: test both arrivals against a defender on the deck and record time to first cover. The pin names the rooftop; the schematic alone cannot show vertical occlusion.
